Reads transaction alerts from banks and UPI apps to fill in your spending. It happens on this phone; no message is sent anywhere.
No message is read again, and everything already read from your messages is deleted.
Fetches gold, crypto and fund prices so your holdings can be valued. Only the price key is sent — never an amount, and never what you own.

Erase everything
This deletes every account, transaction, budget, goal, loan, receipt and conversation on this phone, along with your PIN and your settings.
This cannot be undone. The key your data is locked with is destroyed, so no one — not you, not us, not anyone holding this phone — can read what is left.
A backup file you saved elsewhere is locked with the passphrase you chose, not with this phone\'s key. We cannot reach it. Delete those files yourself if you want them gone.
